headline: Yucatán Consolidates Its Leadership in Meetings Tourism
summary: Yucatán expects 14 meetings in November, drawing 17,450 attendees. The events are forecast to generate 559.6 million pesos in spending.
why: Business tourism and events are an important source of hotel, restaurant and transport revenue in regional Mexican economies. Visitor spending supports local employment.
original_headline: Yucatán consolida su liderazgo en turismo de reuniones
